dedupe_keys.name: catterline nature based slope protection field data tree cover and soil shear strength operandum

description: These two field datasets come from three nature-based solutions built in 2021 to stabilise a slope at Catterline, Scotland: a live cribwall, a live cribwall combined with a live slope grating system, and a live pole drain. The tree cover dataset gives tree cover and architectural traits of the vegetation in each structure, measured during the 2022 growing season, as three CSV files. The companion dataset records soil shear strength measured with a field vane under the same three structures in the summers of 2021 and 2022. Both were collected by Alejandro Gonzalez Ollauri of Glasgow Caledonian University for the UK open-air laboratory of the EU OPERANDUM project on nature-based solutions for hydro-meteorological risks, and published on Zenodo in December 2022 as quality assured versions. The tree cover files are downloadable under CC BY 4.0; the shear strength record shows no files or licence on Zenodo. Caveats: data come from a single site and two seasons, and field vane measurements are point values. It is useful for calibration and validation of slope stability and landslide hazard exposure models that include vegetation, and for resilience studies of green-grey protection for coastal roads and slopes; a related record is the OPERANDUM Emilia-Romagna coastal NBS modelling dataset.
